macros.name: gte_ReadDQA
macros.operation: Read the GTE depth-cue scale control register DQA ($27) into a general register, including the R3000 cfc2 interlock nop.
macros.rationale: Two independent libgte members start with cfc2 of control register $27 (C2_DQA in gtereg.h) followed by nop; the SDK's own C-side read sequences in inline_c.h (gte_ReadGeomScreen) use the same cfc2+nop shape.

macros.name: gte_ReadDQB
macros.operation: Read the GTE depth-cue offset control register DQB ($28) into a general register, including the R3000 cfc2 interlock nop.
macros.rationale: Two independent libgte members read control register $28 (C2_DQB in gtereg.h) with cfc2 followed by nop; the same cfc2+nop shape appears in the SDK's C-side read macros in inline_c.h.
